title: Profiler link exposed (X-Debug-Token-Link header)
description: The response carries X-Debug-Token-Link, which is the Symfony profiler endpoint for the request that produced the page. The link is a token, so anyone who received the response can open the profiler and read collected request data: configuration, SQL, cache keys and, depending on the panels installed, credentials.
remediation: Run the profiler only in development, and strip X-Debug-Token and X-Debug-Token-Link in production. If the profiler must run, restrict it to a trusted network and rotate the debug token store.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the profiler link; it cannot tell whether the profiler endpoint still accepts the token or which panels are enabled.
